**Railroad Service Yard**, or **H&E Rail Service Yard** [1] is a location in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

- Leonard - inside the Train Carriage during Insurrection.
- Highway Town Settlers

Breakroom Key

Railroad Service Yard appears in *Fallout 76*.

The development of the location was assigned to Dan Spedding. [Dev 1]
